hooks.command: tmpfile=$(mktemp); cat > "$tmpfile"; if jq -e '((.tool_input.file_path // "") + " " + (.tool_input.command // "")) | test("devcontainer/[^/]*token")' "$tmpfile" > /dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '{timestamp: (now | todate), status: "BLOCKED", tool: .tool_name, input: .tool_input}' "$tmpfile" >> .claude/audit.log; rm "$tmpfile"; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Access to protected file is blocked."}}'; exit 2; fi; rm "$tmpfile"
